set -eu
stage=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed/.releases/8e35800be335a61d8910b066d2130a05a8dcf9a8/video-dualmode-three-way-stage
new=create-videobot:video-dualmode-deeplink-3ca13539
base=create-videobot:dualmode-runtime-baseline-ca6bad63
test -n "$(docker images -q "$new")" || exit 31
docker run --rm --network none -v "$stage/test:/opt/videobot/test:ro" -w /opt/videobot --entrypoint node "$new" --test test/videoInvoiceSales.test.mjs > "$stage/invoice-tests-only.log" 2>&1 || exit 32
docker run --rm --network none -v "$stage/test:/opt/videobot/test:ro" -w /opt/videobot --entrypoint node "$new" --test --test-name-pattern='invoice' test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs > "$stage/invoice-publisher-only.log" 2>&1 || exit 33
docker run --rm --network none -v "$stage/test:/opt/videobot/test:ro" -w /opt/videobot --entrypoint node "$base" --test test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs > "$stage/publisher-baseline.log" 2>&1 || true
docker run --rm --network none -v "$stage/test:/opt/videobot/test:ro" -w /opt/videobot --entrypoint node "$new" --test test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs > "$stage/publisher-candidate.log" 2>&1 || true
python3 -B - "$stage" <<'PY'
import sys,re
from pathlib import Path
r=Path(sys.argv[1])
def fails(name):
 s=(r/name).read_text(errors='replace')
 if '# tests ' not in s:sys.exit(34)
 return set(re.findall(r'(?m)^not ok \d+ - ([^\n]+)$',s))
if fails('publisher-candidate.log')-fails('publisher-baseline.log'):sys.exit(35)
print('VIDEO_DUALMODE_INVOICE_TESTS_AND_LEGACY_PARITY=PASS')
PY
